messages:
Maya Singh: Hey folks, I accepted the org invite but I can't open some private repos (403). The web UI shows me as "Pending SSO". Anyone run into this before?
Jorge Alvarez: Welcome Maya! Usually that happens if you accepted the invite while logged into a different GitHub account or you haven't completed the SSO enforcement step. Check https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/people to see which account is listed.
Maya Singh: It shows my account maya.dev which is weird because I accepted via my work email maya@redwood.ai. I may have clicked the link while logged into my laptop's GH account.
infra-bot: Automated note: Org requires SAML SSO and 2FA. Users without SAML authorization will see membership as "Outside collaborator" or "Pending" until authorized.
Jorge Alvarez: If you accepted on the wrong account we can revoke the invite and resend to the correct github username/email. Alternatively, you can remove the personal account session in your browser and accept the invite while signed into the right account.
Maya Singh: I don't see the invite anymore in inbox. Could you resend to maya@redwood.ai?
Sam Miller: Done. I revoked the old invite for maya.dev and resent to the work email. When you accept, GitHub should prompt to authorize SSO access. Make sure to click "Authorize" on the org SAML prompt.
Maya Singh: I accepted the new invite and clicked authorize SSO. I can now view repos in the UI but git push still fails with 403 for a private repo.
Jorge Alvarez: Did you add your SSH key to the same GitHub account that is now a member? If you used a key on your personal account it won't work. Also check token permissions if using HTTPS with a PAT.
Maya Singh: Added my SSH key to maya@redwood.ai account and tried `git push` again. Works now. Thanks everyone!
thread_body_preview: Accepted invite with wrong account, infra-bot SSO note, revoke/resend, accept + authorize SSO, SSH key fix.
